notes: Needs ruling: the three last names say «كنا جلوسا عند أبي عبد الله» and then describe the Imam's words and actions in the scene. Whether they are the source of the Imam's words or only present in the scene is not settled by the text; the Imam is not added as a link.
«[10/166] رجال الكشي:» is the source's label, not part of a chain; the compiler is not written (head_of_every_chain false).
